statement: Bind the second semantic editing verb: scope-aware statement-block extraction. A marked 1-based inclusive line region inside a function (qualname addressable, methods included) lifts to a new module-level def inserted immediately before the owning module-level statement (decorator-inclusive), the region replaced by a call at identical indent. Inference law, senior reviewer rules not heuristics: inputs = Load-names bound earlier in the enclosing scope; module-level names NEVER become parameters (they still resolve at module scope); self is just a parameter; outputs = region Store-names read later in the enclosing function (dead writes dropped; 0 -> bare call, 1 -> x = new(...), >=2 -> tuple). Refusals: REGION_NOT_STATEMENT_ALIGNED (partial statements, severed if/else, straddled blocks, headers), RETURN/LOOP_ESCAPE/YIELD/NESTED_DEF_IN_REGION, NEW_NAME_COLLIDES, INVALID_IDENTIFIER, REFUSE_NONLOCAL_OR_GLOBAL, REGION_INDENT_*. Alignment descends into same-scope block statements only (If/For/While/With/Try arms) and never into a nested def/class. Region bytes move verbatim, dedented exactly 4; the extracted def is parse-checked BEFORE the file is touched and the rebuilt module is parse-checked before it is written. A named pytest suite runs post-edit; red restores every original byte and refuses TESTS_RED_AFTER_EDIT; no tests named => verified=false loudly. Golden: world pkg/report.py::summarize, region 12-17 (parity branch with module-global SCALE read and two dead writes) -> def bands(base), call band = bands(base), inputs [base], outputs [band], SCALE stays module scope, suite green post-edit, e2e ~230 ms.
